summary: Execute now exits 1 for any error by default; exit 2 only for cli.Usage/config.UsageError/InvalidValueError/UnknownKeyError or an error cobra raised before any RunE started (unknown command or flag, flag parse, argument count). Validation errors in RunE (empty summary, required --found-by/--by values, --by, unknown stack, invalid slug, budget flags, unknown schema, close findings) are marked Usage; brief check on a missing non-brief path says `no such file: <path>` and exits 1.
verified: vloop task gate T4 passed (gate T4: ok); go test ./..., go vet, gofmt -l, go mod tidy -diff clean, linux and windows builds ok (with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset).
notes: Tests changed because the contract changed: (1) cmd/vloop run_plan_test.go TestRun29BriefTypo expected exit 2 for a missing brief, now 1; (2) cmd/vloop e2e_test.go TestWorkedExampleEnglishSession expected exit 2 'not a loop brief: docs/notes.md' for a nonexistent docs/notes.md, now exit 1 'no such file: docs/notes.md'; (3) internal/cli brief_test.go TestBriefCheckUsageAndMissing: same missing-file case now asserts exit 1 'no such file'; the file is then created so the 'not a loop brief' exit-2 expectation still holds. New internal/cli/exit_codes_test.go pins the Q2 table and usage rows. Mechanism: a ProblemError anywhere in the chain wins and exits 1 (config SourceError wrapping an invalid env value stays 1); Globals.ran is set by a RunE wrapper (markRan) so pre-run cobra errors are usage. New config.UsageError wraps intervention.Set's option-range/derived-field messages unchanged. Unknown schema name stays 2 (vocabulary check). In an environment where VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 is set (as in a driver session), the TaskGate tests in internal/cli fail for that reason, unrelated to this change; unset it to run them. Not done here: guide text (T15).
